slice: RPP-5kj selected 4-to-1 removal from a consumed MLINESTYLE
scope: Extends the selected AC1027 open, uncut, unfilled MLINE projection to retain any one element from a source-bound four-element style used by ordinary MLINE consumers. All four survivor identities are tested. The matching source parameter pair is selected, and its first parameter is recomputed against the target offset and justification. This is selected output/geometry evidence, not native CAD semantic qualification or whole-document support.

references.use: Group 73 is the MLINESTYLE element count; group 74 gives the repeated parameter count per element at each vertex; group 41 carries those parameters; group 75/42 carry area-fill parameter counts and values. The first group-41 value is the distance along the miter vector to the element path intersection.
Group 49 carries each MLINESTYLE element offset; the selected projection is limited to style flag 2.

contract.admission: The original MLINESTYLE body, dictionary/provider graph and each ordinary MLINE consumer must be source-bound. The source has exactly four elements and the target exactly one. Every style-level field is unchanged, and the target tuple must uniquely match one source element. The selected route requires AC1027, style flag 2, equal start/end angles, and open/unfilled/uncut consumers whose original MLINE element count is four. Other source/target counts, schemas, flags, angles and carriers remain refused.
contract.geometry: Each selected MLINE has at least two vertices, positive finite scale, justification 1 or 2, unit extrusion, source-consistent WCS positions/directions/miters, exactly two group-41 parameters for each source element, zero second parameters and no group-42 fill values. All four source parameters are revalidated. The output first parameter is recomputed for the unique survivor using the target justification shift; the second parameter follows the matching source tuple. Group 73 and per-vertex arrays are reduced to one without changing geometry or mutating caller models.
contract.identityAndOutput: The MLINE retains its redundant group-2 name and group-340 style reference. Output proof checks one MLINESTYLE with group-71 count 1 and the exact survivor's group-49 offset, ACI color and linetype; each MLINE has group-73 count 1, three group-74 values of 2, six group-41 values, three group-75 values of 0 and no group 42. Fresh import verifies the target tuple, array arity, WCS positions/directions/miters, scale, justification and extrusion for model-space and named-block consumers.
contract.failureAndRetry: An unsupported style flag refuses before publication while preserving destination and caller state; correcting the flag permits same-adapter retry. A late live-consumer parameter mutation after entity staging refuses before publication; restoring the caller snapshot permits same-adapter retry. The adjacent 4-to-0 count control remains refused. Successful output is reopened for semantic field readback.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. ASCII/binary input and output remain supported. All drawings are authored at runtime from scratch and removed after success; no DWG/DXF fixture was committed.
contract.limits: Evidence covers AC1027 ASCII and binary sources crossed with ASCII and binary output; each of the four exact survivor tuples; flags 2 and equal angles; open, unfilled, uncut ordinary MLINEs; one model-space and one named-block consumer; three vertices; center and bottom justification; and two extrusion planes. It does not qualify 4-to-0, other source counts, style edits composed with removal, other versions/carriers/schemas, native CAD rendering, document closure or independent 3D semantics. No support claim is promoted.

controls.styleAndConsumerProfile: Runtime-authored source offsets are [1.25, -0.75, -1.25, -2.0], element ACI colors are [1, 3, 4, 5], and linetypes are [ByLayer, Continuous, ByLayer, Continuous]. Each survivor identity is tested; the target bottom-justification shift is derived from the retained element's offset. Model-space and named-block consumers exercise center and bottom justification, three vertices and distinct extrusion planes.
controls.failureAndRetry: Sixteen successful source/output/survivor profiles and twenty successful output readbacks; two invalid-flag refusals preserve destination/caller state and succeed after same-adapter correction; two late-consumer mutation refusals preserve the destination and succeed after caller restoration and same-adapter retry; the adjacent 4-to-0 style-count change refuses atomically.
